# Emergency Procedures
These procedures apply whenever the office or its staff are under threat. Corporate Security has authority during an emergency, and its instructions override this handbook.
## Hostile Intrusion Any threat to staff counts: armed intruders, rioters, wild animals or anything else. Staff are not to wait until they're sure. - Staff who can leave safely must leave immediately. Belongings are to be left behind. - Staff who can't leave must lock themselves in the nearest room with a lockable door, stay away from doors and windows, and keep quiet. - Once safe, staff must report the threat on the Company radio channel: what it is, where it is, and how many there are. - Staff must stay where they are until Security gives the all-clear, and may not open doors to anyone they can't identify. - Staff may not engage intruders.
## Lockdown - When Security locks down the office, staff are to stay where they are and keep doors closed. - Staff may not override or force a locked door.
## Evacuation - When the site is evacuated, staff are to go straight to the point Security names and stay with the group. - Staff may not go back for belongings. - When a Company shuttle is sent, staff must be at the landing zone on time. The shuttle doesn't wait.
## Injuries - Injured staff are to go to colonial medical staff as soon as it is safe. - Staff with an injured colleague should stay with them if they can, call for help and tell Security where they are.
## Fire - Staff are to leave the room, close the door and report the fire. - Extinguishers may only be used on small fires, and only by staff who know how to use them.
## After an Incident - Staff must give the Liaison a written account of what they saw. - Incidents may not be discussed with anyone outside the Company. Questions are to be referred to the Liaison. - Staff who are struggling after an incident should tell the Liaison.
